description: The lower Nemunas outputs link HEC-RAS, SWAT and SHYFEM at five gauges. Daily calibration covers 2009 to 2015 and validation 2016 to 2020, with profiles and climate-driven projections also provided. This resource is provided by Chala Hailu, Sime; Mėžinė, Jovita; Ali, Ertürk and coauthors. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists TIF, ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The text and example table use inconsistent water-level units, so units must be resolved before quantitative reuse. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence.
